description: Pump model configuration focused on two real cases only: chilled-water total-header flow allocation and cooling-water facility-flow aggregation allocation. Pump head H is read directly from each pump head point.

equal.description: Allocate total group flow equally to all running pumps.

by_speed_ratio.description: Allocate total group flow by each running pump speed ratio. Use this when parallel pumps run at different frequencies and pump models are similar.

by_rated_flow_speed.description: Allocate total group flow by rated flow and speed ratio. Use this when parallel pumps have different rated flow values.
by_rated_flow_speed.formula: Q_i = Q_total * rated_flow_i * w_i / sum(rated_flow_j * w_j)

pump_groups.name: Chilled water pump group 1
pump_groups.description: Chilled-water side: read one total-header flow point, then allocate Q_total to running chilled-water pumps.

pump_groups.name: Cooling water pump group 1
pump_groups.description: Cooling-water side: sum flow points from each cooling facility, then allocate Q_total to running cooling-water pumps.

flow_source.formula: Q_total = sum(flow of running cooling facilities)

calculation_steps: Select one pump group by side and group id.
Keep only running pumps by pump status.
For chilled_water groups, read Q_total directly from the configured total_flow point.
For cooling_water groups, sum the configured facility flow points, optionally only for running facilities.
Calculate each running pump speed ratio: w_i = frequency_i / rated_frequency_i.
Allocate Q_total to each running pump according to allocation.method.
Read each pump head directly: H_i = configured pump.head point.
Calculate each pump efficiency: eta_i = 0.002725 * Q_i * H_i / power_i.

output_schema.description: The calculation layer should normalize both group strategies into this row format before regression.

head_curve.formula: H = a * Q^2 + b * w * Q + c * w^2

efficiency_curve.formula: eta = j * (Q / w)^2 + k * (Q / w) + l
